cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:92.title: Project Manager Diesel Technician
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:92.description: Our client is a premier utility company specializing in rapid response and storm chasing to utility companies and contractors in need of a quick reaction force to repair power outages when they need it most. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide reliable and efficient solutions to help our clients restore power quickly and effectively during emergencies and adverse weather conditions while ensuring operational efficiency and financial sustainability. Our customers are our communities, and when they need us, we are there. We are seeking a skilled and experienced Fleet Mechanic to maintain our fleet maintenance while supporting our rapid response and restoration services. The Fleet Operations Lead Mechanic will play a critical role in the upkept and readiness of our fleet of vehicles, equipment, and assets to ensure optimal performance, safety, and efficiency. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial vehicle maintenance and maintenance schedules.
responsibilities: Fleet Maintenance:
Regularly review preventative maintenance schedules and ensure all vehicles are being maintained according to schedule
Diagnoses minor mechanical and electronic problems, utilizing diagnostic computer when applicable
Addresses all identified maintenance needs in an efficient manner while ensuring compliance with maintenance reporting requirements
Oversees and leads the emergency response maintenance and repairs as needed
Asset Availability & Utilization:
Ensure repairs are efficiently addressed to maintain asset availability for projects, jobs, and emergency responses.
Analyze asset data to identify opportunities for optimization, including right-sizing the fleet, improving asset utilization, and minimizing downtime.
Assist in developing preventive maintenance schedules and programs to extend the lifespan of fleet assets and reduce maintenance costs.
Equipment Safety and Compliance:
Assist in enforcing safety policies and procedures to ensure the safe operation of fleet vehicles and equipment.
Participate in regular safety training and inspections, addressing any safety concerns or violations promptly.
Assist in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including vehicle inspections, emissions testing, and driver licensing.
Emergency Response Support:
Assist in deploying fleet assets and personnel rapidly in response to emergencies and power outages.
Assist to ensure the readiness and availability of fleet resources during emergency situations.
Oversees and efficiently utilizes emergency mechanical support to ensure any mechanical opportunities are effectively addressed.
qualifications: Certifications in commercial fleet maintenance, as well as a minimum of 5 years proven fleet maintenance experience.
Strong knowledge of vehicle maintenance schedules, hands-on experience in diesel engine and/or heavy vehicle maintenance, diagnosis, repair, and safety compliance.
Excellent communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
CDL Preferred

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4f0a8f34-10fa-.title: Senior Global Compensation Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4f0a8f34-10fa-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Global Compensation Analyst based in United States. This role supports the design, administration, and optimization of global compensation programs across a portfolio of internationally recognized luxury brands. You will play a key role in analyzing compensation data, benchmarking pay, and supporting annual merit and incentive processes. The position combines analytical rigor with cross-functional collaboration across HR, Finance, and global stakeholders. You’ll work with confidential employee and compensation data while helping ensure programs remain competitive, consistent, and aligned with business needs. The role offers exposure to global total rewards strategy, equity administration, bonus programs, and workforce analytics. Success requires strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights. Support the ongoing assessment, development, and optimization of global compensation strategies and programs across multiple international brands and markets. Administer equity compensation programs, including processing new grants, maintaining documentation, and managing required approvals and records. Maintain corporate bonus accrual files, collaborate with Finance on expected attainment, and coordinate year-end incentive payments. Prepare and distribute Target Agreement Forms for corporate bonus plans and support the administration of annual merit and variable compensation cycles. Complete global salary survey submissions, analyze market data, and translate survey findings into actionable compensation insights. Conduct competitive compensation benchmarking, financial modeling, statistical analysis, and program costing to support compensation decisions. Prepare clear charts, reports, presentations, and data visualizations related to compensation, benefits, and HR analytics initiatives. Partner effectively with HR, Finance, and other stakeholders to resolve compensation-related questions and support accurate, timely program execution. Handle sensitive and confidential compensation information with professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in a business-related discipline, ideally with an emphasis in finance, mathematics, computer science, or a comparable quantitative field. At least 3 years of professional compensation experience, including hands-on exposure to at least one annual merit cycle. Strong understanding of compensation analysis, benchmarking, incentive programs, equity administration, and broader total rewards practices. Expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with the ability to perform sophisticated data analysis and financial modeling in Excel; an Excel assessment may be part of the selection process. Experience working with an HRIS platform; Workday experience is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret complex data and identify meaningful trends or issues. Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple deadlines and highly sensitive information. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at different levels. Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential employee and compensation data, including the ability to escalate issues appropriately. A collaborative, adaptable, results-oriented approach and the curiosity to work effectively in a fast-paced, continuously changing environment. Benefits Competitive annual compensation range of $90,000–$105,000 USD , depending on role requirements, skills, experience, and other relevant factors. Generous paid time off and holiday schedule. 401(k) matching program. Paid parental leave. Wellness support through a Thrive Wellness Program. Commuter benef

jobgether-jobgether:lever:a8ba8630-1b09-.title: Director IS Enterprise Systems
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a8ba8630-1b09-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director IS Enterprise Systems based in the United States. The Director IS Enterprise Systems provides strategic and operational leadership for critical enterprise business platforms supporting a large, complex organization. The role oversees platforms such as ERP, IT service management, robotic process automation, and other non-clinical enterprise systems. You will own the technology lifecycle from roadmap development and governance through upgrades, integrations, testing, production support, and optimization. The position combines strategic planning with operational leadership, ensuring platforms remain secure, stable, scalable, and aligned with business priorities. You will lead managers and cross-functional teams while coordinating closely with vendors, implementation partners, managed service providers, and enterprise stakeholders. A key focus will be strengthening automation capabilities and establishing effective governance, support, and delivery models across the technology portfolio. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an enterprise systems professional who can balance technology strategy, operational excellence, business needs, and continuous improvement. Lead the strategy, management, and operational support of enterprise platforms, including ERP, IT service management, RPA, and other assigned business applications. Establish and maintain technology roadmaps, lifecycle strategies, support models, governance processes, and operational standards for assigned platforms. Oversee the full technology lifecycle, including platform ownership, upgrades, patches, integrations, data flows, release governance, testing, production readiness, and post-release support. Provide leadership and guidance to team managers responsible for platform operations, ensuring service stability, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. Partner with program managers and PMO teams to align enterprise platform initiatives with strategic priorities, project timelines, and organizational objectives. Lead the enterprise RPA and automation platform and center of excellence, overseeing intake, prioritization, standards, development support, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production operations. Develop effective automation governance and promote scalable, standardized approaches to enterprise process automation. Manage relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including licensing, contracts, deliverables, customer success, and performance management. Oversee platform budgets, contracts, resources, and operational investments to ensure effective use of technology resources. Ensure enterprise integrations, APIs, data flows, identity and access considerations, security requirements, and environment management practices support reliable platform operations. Establish strong release management, testing, regression testing, and production readiness practices to minimize operational risk and disruption. Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, efficiency, reliability, scalability, and business value. Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to understand evolving needs and translate them into sustainable enterprise technology solutions. Provide leadership during complex incidents, operational issues, and platform changes, ensuring timely resolution and clear stakeholder communication. Travel periodically to various locations within Indiana for leadership meetings and other business needs. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Healthcare Management, Information Systems, or a related field is required; a master’s degree is preferred. 7+ years of progressively responsible experience leading enterprise systems, business platforms, SaaS applications, ERP systems, IT service management platforms, automation platfor

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:4b304f3c-a2f.title: Senior Product Manager
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:4b304f3c-a2f.description: "Pairs" is an online dating app used by more than 27 million people in Japan. Since launch, we have received success stories from over 900,000 people. Pairs is the first-in-market to offer 24/7 in-house customer service, including text and image monitoring, so our users' safety and security are always ensured. We created Pairs to help singles discover new and interesting ways to find a life partner. In the United States, more than 1 in 3 couples met their partner online. In Japan more than 70 per cent of singles claim to have no partner. As the number 1 online dating service in Japan, we're working hard every day to help singles find their true love. Since the release of Pairs in October 2012, we have helped to create opportunities for many users to find partnership and marriage. Pairs offers the opportunity to find an ideal partner that matches one's own values through various search features and a well-developed MyTag. Everyday, we receive many reports of successful matches from across Japan and from overseas. It is our hope that more and more opportunities for wonderful relationships will be created, which inspires us to improve our service every day. Job Summary： We are seeking a highly driven and experienced Product Manager to take full ownership of delivering impactful app and web features. In this role, you will bridge business objectives with user needs through effective stakeholder management, partnering closely with senior leadership (including CxOs) to shape direction and drive measurable impact across both the Japanese and global markets.
responsibilities: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle: Identify and validate new opportunities through market/user research, write clear and actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), collaborate with design and engineering throughout the development process, and conduct post-release data analysis to evaluate performance and inform continuous improvements.

Shape and deliver the product roadmap: Build a forward-looking roadmap that reflects both business priorities and user needs, ensuring clarity of vision across teams. Communicate the roadmap effectively to align executives, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams, and adapt it as market conditions and insights evolve.

Drive stakeholder management at all levels: Partner with CxOs and senior executives by presenting persuasive business and user logic, facilitating alignment across multiple functions. Proactively manage stakeholder expectations, secure buy-in for new initiatives, and provide clear, structured updates on progress and learnings.

Measure and track impact: Establish and monitor Key Growth Indicators (KGI) and Key Performance Indicators (KPI), reporting on a daily, weekly, and monthly cadence. Leverage insights from data tools to drive accountability, optimize features, and ensure the team remains focused on measurable outcomes.
Enable organizational growth: Act as a mentor and coach for junior product managers, providing guidance on tools, frameworks, and best practices.
qualifications: Approx. 7 years of experience in product development and management.

Manage the end-to-end feature development lifecycle, including identifying opportunities, writing Product Requirements Documents (PRD), managing development process, and conducting post-release data analysis.
Strong experience in defining and executing product roadmaps that align with business goals.
Ability to measure and communicate product impact on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis using KGIs and KPIs.
Collaborate closely with the core development team and market teams to ensure the growth/success of the project
Experience coaching or mentoring junior product managers.
Experience in product globalization or localization as product manager or relevant roles.
Direct experience working with senior executives and presenting to leadership teams.
International company working experience

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:679f6449-0b8.description: We are are seeking to place English > Chinese certified interpreters, with a competitive hourly rate for a Rhode Island state department contract. Requirements: - 5 to 7 years of interpretation experience - Certification from ATA, NCSC, FCICE, or other recognized interpretation credentials - We are seeking certified applicants only - if not court certified, other certification is also acceptable, please indicate certification level. - Native-level fluency in Chinese (please specify if dialect-specific) - Fluent in English - Hourly rates If you are interested in this assignment, as well as any future interpretation assignments we receive for your language pair, please apply with a recently updated version of your CV and your hourly rate (plus any consequential rates or parameters) for consideration.
